Deliveries.explanation: Offers go SEQUENTIALLY, one shipper at a time, ride-hailing style: the closest verified, available shipper within 5 km receives a 15-second offer. Acceptance assigns the delivery; rejection immediately moves to the next; letting an offer lapse sets the shipper's is_available = false - because nobody is actually at the device, leaving them available would block the queue for every later order. Status chain: assigned -> heading_to_provider -> qc_completed (with photo) -> in_transit -> delivered. The last step MANDATORILY scans the receiver's QR token as proof the food reached the right person; only then is the reservation completed and trust/dedication points awarded. Shippers push GPS coordinates during the trip; receivers watch the order in real time. NotificationsGateway forwards each location into the dedicated socket room of each side, so the map updates without polling REST. The shipper cancels, or the system marks a delivery failed. Marking failed restores the listing stock and tells the receiver to re-order. NO trust penalty is applied when the cause is 'no shipper accepted in time' - the receiver did nothing wrong.

NotificationsGateway.description: Socket.IO gateway that authenticates each connection with the JWT and emits events into per-user rooms.

methods.+handleConnection(client: Socket): void: Verifies the handshake JWT, joins the user:{userId} room, sets up disconnect cleanup.
methods.+emitToUser(userId: string, event: strin: Emits the event into the user:{userId} room only.

PrismaService.description: Prisma ORM client wrapper. Each field exposes a model delegate used by services to issue typed queries and mutations.

StorageService.description: Local-disk image storage with MIME + magic-byte validation. Production deployments swap this implementation for S3 / R2 / Cloudinary without touching callers.

methods.+saveImage(file: File, subdir: string):: Validates the file, picks a path under {uploadRoot}/{subdir}/, writes the buffer, returns the public URL.
methods.+imageExists(url: string): Promise<boole: Cheap existence probe used by cleanup jobs.
methods.-matchesMagicBytes(buffer: Buffer, mimet: Verifies the file signature matches the declared MIME type.

TrustService.description: Trust-score writer: applies a signed delta with a reason, persists a trust_score_history row, and re-evaluates the restricted / banned thresholds (60 / 30).

methods.+applyDelta(userId: string, delta: numbe: Adjusts users.trust_score, writes a history row, applies restricted/banned status when thresholds are crossed.

NotificationsService.description: Single entry point for emitting notifications; persists the row, then pushes the payload into the user's socket room through NotificationsGateway. Idempotent via dedupeKey.
